A defined scope

Know what we
are building together.

Requirements, deliverables, and acceptance criteria are agreed for your project. The items below are topics to define during discovery, rather than a fixed package.

  • Current-state review and infrastructure requirements
  • Proposed cloud or platform architecture
  • Agreed deployment and configuration workflows
  • Operational checks and documentation
  • Migration, release, and support responsibilities

Common questions

Before we begin.

Do we need to move everything to the cloud?

No. A review can compare the current setup with possible changes. The right decision depends on application needs, costs, constraints, and team responsibilities.

Can you work with an existing deployment process?

Yes. We can assess the process and propose scoped improvements instead of replacing it without a clear reason.

Do cloud services include ongoing support?

Ongoing support is a separate scope to agree on. Monitoring coverage, response times, responsibilities, and exclusions should be documented in the proposal.
